facts.fact: The Ministry of Health piloted the mHealth.ci community health platform in five districts of the Poro region from December 2024 (full operational launch 8 January 2025), and the authors state it integrates with the national health information system DHIS2.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health (DSCPS, DIS, DISD) with UNICEF
systems.tiers: community health workers; frontline health workers
